messages:
Alice Park: Heads up — finance flagged that our Console shows overall spend but not token-level unit economics. They specifically want cache savings broken out by model and route (so they can validate billing and negotiate pricing). Who owns adding per-route token/caching columns in the dashboard?
Devon Hayes: I can take a stab at it. Proposed metrics: tokens_generated, tokens_cached, cache_hit_rate, gross_cost, cache_savings, net_cost, model_name, route_id. compute cache_savings = tokens_cached * model_unit_cost * cache_multiplier. Need to agree on what we mean by tokens_cached (prefix vs KV shared).
Maya Singh: Product asks: show "estimated customer price impact" = net_cost / requests and allow aggregation windows (1h, 24h, 7d). UI should have a toggle to attribute cache savings to route vs model.
Eli Turner: From finance: we need per-tenant rollups (billing_customer_id). Cannot ship raw token logs — must be aggregated. Also need CSV export and a stable BQ join key. Can this be done without blowing up query cost on telemetry?
Devon Hayes: Telemetry plan idea: emit a small per-request telemetry blob at ingestion with ints: tokens_total, tokens_prefix_cached, tokens_kv_cached, model_id, route_id, billing_customer_id. Do streaming pre-aggregation (tumbling windows) to materialize hourly stats. Store in TSDB for fast UI and daily partitions in BigQuery for exports. That keeps UI QPS low.
Alice Park: How do we handle partial KV hits vs full prefix hits? Customers will debate attribution.
Devon Hayes: We'll capture `prefix_hit_tokens` and `kv_shared_hit_tokens` separately. UI rollups will surface combined `cache_hits` and have a hover breakdown: {prefix: X, kv_shared: Y}. Backend requires a telemetry schema bump (small int fields).
Maya Singh: UX asks: surface per-model unit cost (e.g., cost per 1k tokens per model variant) and allow customers (and Dedicated deployments) to override unit costs per deployment. Also add a "what-if" slider to simulate cache improvements (e.g., +10% cache => cost delta).
Eli Turner: +1 to the what-if. Also ensure we have retention policies and privacy gating — aggregated only by default. Dedicated customers might expose more detailed telemetry; treat that as an opt-in feature.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: telemetry schema v2.11 deployed to staging (build 2026.03.18.5)
Devon Hayes: I'll open an RFC and a PR: will include schema diffs, pipeline changes (streaming aggregation), BQ table spec, and UI wireframes. Action list: (1) schema + ingestion change, (2) streaming pre-agg, (3) TSDB materialized views, (4) BQ export, (5) Console UI: table + hover breakdown + what-if slider, (6) permission gating and CSV export.
Alice Park: Please include permission notes: finance can see aggregated per-tenant but not raw request IDs. Also call out edge cases: Dedicated instances lacking KV instrumentation — we need fallbacks where `tokens_kv_cached` may be null.
Maya Singh: Will attach mockups to the RFC and propose placements in the cost dashboard (per-route tab).
Eli Turner: For billing reconciliation, include daily snapshots and a stable `billing_customer_id` key. Also flag differences between hosted vs dedicated unit costs.
Devon Hayes: Cool — will cc @Maya and ping infra for a quick rollout plan. Expect RFC in the next 48h.
Alice Park: Perfect, thanks.
